name: Corkscrew
look: a winged steel wine-opener sprite with lever-arm wings and a spiral drill tail
entry: Corkscrew spins rapidly to bore through wooden casks and dense tree bark. The sound of it taking flight echoes like a popping bottle.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
It learns Pop Off at level 17.
